reviews.t: Wonderful Conditioner for Thick Dry/Course/Colored Hair! (Bloom)
reviews.x: You need to know something about me - I am a conditioner snob! I have thick course color treated hair and I won't just use anything and most products are not great for me. I feel I have tried them all...Pureology, Aveda, Lanza, Joico, R&Co, Oribe....list goes on. Meanwhile I do not want to buy or use plastic if I can help it and I found Ethique products and they are stellar! A few months ago I bought the Ethique conditioner bar and I did not like it - not enough conditioning. Then I discovered t

I love this product! It was very easy to mix up, and the bar melted nicely into the hot water. The consistency is perfect and the peppermint scent is very refreshing. It left my hair feeling soft and rinsed cleanly. I love Ethique shampoo bars but the solid conditioner always left my hair feeling tangled and dry. This is perfect! My one piece of feedback is that the peppermint is VERY prominent and completely covers the lavender. I find it refreshing and I enjoyed the slight minty tingle feeling

reviews.t: Great product (tip about using a whisk)
reviews.x: I have purchased this now three times, and I can say that I am super pleased with this conditioner. I get compliments on how healthy my hair looks, and it overall leaves my hair with a nice volume (not too much) and a great smell.  A note about making the conditioner: After trial and error, I discovered the best way to make this and not end up with any lumps (which eventually dissolve) is to break the bar up into a glass or metal bowl, and then once you pour in the boiling water, use a metal whi

I liked the conditioner bar way better than this liquid conditioner but this wasn’t that bad either. Since I love bar much more I won’t purchase this again.  I tried bar conditioners and was happy with it because it really really lasts forever. I cannot deny it takes a few seconds more to apply the conditioner bar than liquid so I decided to try this.  Smell - I was ok with the smell itself. Some says strong and I can understand but it isn’t too bad to my standard and certainly it did not bother

Really happy with this concentrate. I did not expect it to work well but am very thankful to be wrong. It thickens to the normal consistency of conditioners after it cools. It’s very moisturizing for my thick curly hair. My only issue was the scent. Very strong herbal scent. It was not really my thing but a little added essential oil was all it needed. However, in the future I’ll just order the unscented and add my own scent

I live in a very dry area and my hair needs lots of moisturizing. Although I like the idea of conditioner without the plastic bottle, this does not work for my hair. I need more moisturizing than this conditioner provides. I also did not much like the smell, but it did not make me sneeze like many other conditioners with a strong scent.  Mixing it up takes a bit of patience. You start stirring around these chunks in water and wonder if this is going to work. Keep stirring, it does work, you do g

reviews.t: Works well, but scent is overpowering
reviews.x: I've really tried to decrease my plastic use, so I ordered shampoo and conditioner bars from ethique. I love the shampoo bars because they lather up easily, but I wasn't a fan of the conditioner bars because it was so hard to spread on my hair. So when I saw the concentrate version, I was pumped. The instructions were clear and easy to follow, and it was just like normal conditioner from a plastic bottle.  The only problem is the smell. Wow, it's strong. Like makes my eyes water strong. If they

I dont normally do reviews but the shampoo box came already opened and slightly damaged. Pretty sure both the shampoo and conditioner bar might be old considering since both have this chalky and dusty surface. I normally dont care about being sent damaged products as i can just refund them or get a new one but i think its slightly concerning that they might not check the quality or date of the product before shipping.

I've used ethique conditioner bars before and absolutely hated them. They made my hair feel like sticky straw. But then they made this concentrate and my goodness they redeemed themselves! It smells great, it's very hydrating, it makes my hair nice and soft. It's thick and creamy like a normal conditioner and for the price its fantastic! Highly recommend 👌

Y'all were not joking about the smell! Ethique bars are great, they leave my hair feeling nice and they last for ev er...... So I thought I'd try this I'd be happier about saving the world from this one plastic bottle if it didn't cost so much And my hair stinks like.... medicine?????. Just sayin

I really wanted to like this product. It’s easy enough to make just make sure you cut up the product in small chunks. I just don’t think it liked my hair. This actually seemed to dry out my hair more than hydrate it. I have very long very fine hair and this just didn’t work sadly.

Should have paid closer attention to the size. I paid $10.00 for a bar the size of my thumb. The fragrance was listed as 'Bloom,' but it smells like Bengay ointment.  My bad - Didn't realize I needed to add water. Still don't like the smell...
Love the concept and love reducing waste, but mint smell is overwhelming and ruins the shower experience.

reviews.t: Exactly what I was missing in the bar conditioner
reviews.x: I use the Wonderbar solid conditioner, and while it's great for travel, I just felt like my hair wasn't getting properly moisturized. I have been missing my liquid conditioner but am pretty committed to not buying plastic bottles...I was so relieved to see that this product exists! This gives me exactly the conditioned feeling I was looking for. For those of you wondering how to store this, I've found that a 12oz pump bottle, like a leftover Mrs. Meyers hand soap bottle, works perfectly for the

I love that this is eco friendly but there is something to be desired. I tried the bar conditioners but they don't last very long on my 12 inches of hair and didn't get a great lather. The concentrate gets a better lather and is easy to mix with water. It doesn't have the thick consistency until the water cools (then it feels like normal conditioner) so it was still easy to pour into a bottle. And the print on the box is SO tiny that you can hardly see how to make it!  But, I thought, what the heck I'll go ahead and make it.  I broke the bar up and put it in a bowl. reviews.t: Great conditioner without the plastic bottle!
reviews.x: After using this over a month, I am loving this hydrating conditioner. I was unsure about making it when I first put it into the hot water but soon the watery soapy solution resulted in beautiful creamy conditioner just like you'd buy in a bottle. I poured it into a glass soap dispenser and just three short pumps (maybe a quarter-size or less total) works great on my long, medium-thickness hair. It's kind of minty smelling so maybe Peppermint Bloom would be a good name for it, but it's not tingl

First of all, this is a great conditioner, you’ll enjoy using it. But I really think Ethique is shooting themselves in the foot with the instructions. The package instructions claim you can just dissolve it in hot water, but the reality is that you NEED to whisk it at boiling for a minute for the mixture to really incorporate. It’s an emulsion, for heck’s sake. Anyone who knows even a little about cosmetic chemistry understands this, and that’s gotta be 97% of Ethique’s customer base. Just plan

I have very long, thick hair, so using a conditioner BAR meant spending too much time trying to get it to melt and spread evenly.  This concentrated conditioner was just the solution I was looking for.  No plastic bottle that will take hundred of years to break down.  Even the box is compostable.  In the same time it takes to make my tea, I made conditioner.  I boiled water, added the concentrate, stirred for a few minutes, and later, after it cooled, I found a creamy conditioner. reviews.x: I was surprised how well it did dissolve into a typical conditioner with a thick creamy texture. The minty smell was nice, strong but not crazy and it didn't linger. It rinsed out cleanly and left my hair soft. I have fine hair that gets easily tangled. I just didn't think it detangled my hair well, and left more frizz than I had hoped. I don't usually products with silicones/sulfates/parabens etc., So I know it just wasn't because of that. Overall I was impressed but hoping they can work on the

I have long, curly hair and have been looking for a conditioner that will tame the frizzies but eliminate the plastic.  I have tried conditioner bars and have one I like that I will use while traveling but it takes too long to coat my hair with it for regular use.  When you add hot water to this bar it seems like it will be too thin but it thickens up and goes on nicely.  I generally steer away from scents but this is a nice light scent that doesn't bother my allergies.  I don't use shampoo at a

reviews.t: So far I really like it!
reviews.x: I’ve tried several conditioner bars and none of them seemed to work very well for me. I have semi dry, thick, and wavy hair. I saw these concentrate bars and decided to give it a try. I’ve used it twice now and it seems to moisturize my hair pretty well and doesn’t leave it weighed down. I still use my leave in conditioner after the shower because my hair needs it. I love the Bloom scent, very refreshing. I’ve spent way more on conditioners in the past, and I think this works just as well as mos

I've been searching for a conditioner that doesn't use a plastic bottle but that actually works on my hair. Bar conditioners have not worked. (Side note, bar shampoo works like a charm) I was super skeptical about this product but I took the leap and made it per the instructions and wow I was amazed that it actually worked. I have somewhat thick hair that frizzes into weird curls/waves when air dry. This conditioner does pretty well taming the knots and helping define the curls. Really nice also

We bought this conditioner in an endless effort to reduce our plastic waste. Its very easy to melt and the texture of the conditioner is thick and creamy. I have thick and coarse type 2C hair and this conditioner softens my hair very well.  I also really like the eucalyptus scent.  The downside is that this bar doesn't make a lot of conditioner. reviews.t: Works well, needs a little modification to simplify your end
reviews.x: This is super easy to make.  When it cools it is just a bottle of liquid conditioner.  Honestly it took too long for someone to come up with this  I made it right in a plastic bottle.  I tested the bottle with boiling water first to make sure it would handle it.  Then I cut the cubes with scissors (cuts pretty easy) into smaller bits so that they fit in the bottle I wanted to reuse.  That part was a little messy and I had to gather up all the bits with an index card but worth it to save the step

claims.text: Many reviewers find the conditioner hydrating and softening, leaving hair soft, moisturized, and healthy-looking.
The scent is a common complaint, with several reviewers finding it too strong, herbal, or medicinal.
Reviewers appreciate the eco-friendly, low-waste concept and prefer this concentrate over the solid conditioner bars.
Some reviewers find it not moisturizing enough or drying for their hair type.
A few reviewers mention issues with product condition or size, such as a damaged/old-looking box or a very small bar.
